boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented campus spaces for studying, meeting, reflection, recreation, art, and student support beyond a standard tour stop.

cards.entity_name: Memorial Union Third Floor Study Space
cards.title: Memorial Union Third Floor Study Space
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, third floor
cards.notes: Bring a reading or laptop upstairs when you need a calmer work setting; UND identifies this floor as dedicated to quiet study, reading, and assignments.
cards.short_summary: A window-lined quiet-work floor inside the campus union.
cards.evidence_claim: UND describes the Memorial Union's third floor as a calm, quiet space for students to study, read, or complete assignments.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Memorial Union; follow current building access and room-use guidance.

cards.title: Memorial Union Gaming Area
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Room 006
cards.notes: Use the lower-level games area as a planned break between classes; check the Union building map for its room location before heading down.
cards.short_summary: A named lower-level recreation stop in the Memorial Union.
cards.evidence_claim: UND lists the Gaming Area in Memorial Union Room 006 among the building's amenities.
cards.source_title: Services & Amenities | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: In Room 006; access follows Memorial Union operating and event conditions.

cards.title: Memorial Union Gallery
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, main level
cards.notes: Pause for the current exhibition while crossing the Union; the gallery rotates shows about every 90 days and highlights campus and visiting artists.
cards.short_summary: A student-operated gallery with regularly changing exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UND says the Memorial Union Gallery hosts multiple exhibitions yearly, changing approximately every 90 days, and is operated by students.
cards.source_title: Memorial Union Gallery | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The gallery page posts current exhibition dates and gallery hours; verify them before visiting.

cards.title: Pride Center
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Room 204
cards.notes: Stop in to socialize, study, ask for support, or connect with resources; appointments are recommended when you need guaranteed staff meeting time.
cards.short_summary: A staffed Union space for connection, study, and LGBTQIA2S+ support.
cards.evidence_claim: UND describes the Pride Center as a welcoming space where students can socialize, study, find support, and connect to resources.
cards.source_title: About Us | Pride Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Room 204; open during Memorial Union business hours, with staff listed Monday through Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m.

cards.title: The Hilyard Center
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Room 201
cards.notes: Visit for connection and student-support programming, or speak with staff about resources and identity exploration; appointments and drop-ins are both noted by UND.
cards.short_summary: A Memorial Union center built around belonging, collaboration, and student support.
cards.evidence_claim: UND says The Hilyard Center cultivates connections, shared experiences, acceptance, student support, and programming.
cards.source_title: The Hilyard Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Located in Memorial Union Room 201; confirm current staff availability before a dedicated visit.

cards.title: International Center
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Suite 300
cards.notes: Check its programming calendar or contact the center for support and conversation sessions; it serves international and domestic campus engagement.
cards.short_summary: A Union-based hub for international student support and global engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that its International Center supports students through advising, programming, and free English Conversation Sessions.
cards.source_title: International Student & Scholar Services | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Suite 300 in the Memorial Union; English Conversation Sessions require contacting the center to sign up.

cards.title: Memorial Union Reflection Room
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Room 339
cards.notes: Use this designated reflection space for a quiet pause or spiritual practice; be considerate of others and check room availability before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A named upper-floor space for reflection and spiritual wellbeing.
cards.evidence_claim: UND lists Memorial Union Reflection Room 339 among its campus spiritual wellness spaces.
cards.source_title: Religion & Spirituality | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Room 339; availability may be affected by scheduled observances or programming.

cards.title: Wellness Center Resource Lounge
cards.subtitle: Wellness Center, first floor
cards.notes: Bring coursework to the Resource Lounge when a wellness-focused study setting helps; members can use its computers for email, homework, or research.
cards.short_summary: A wellness-center study nook with health resources and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: UND describes the Wellness Center Resource Lounge as a study space with computers for homework, email, and health-information searches.
cards.source_title: Wellness Center Features | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The Wellness Center requires a membership card for facility entry; confirm membership eligibility and facility hours.

cards.title: Hopper Danley Memorial Quiet Lounge
cards.subtitle: Wellness Center, first floor
cards.notes: Choose this lounge for quiet studying, meditation, or a reset between commitments; its outdoor view and floor labyrinth support reflective use.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Wellness Center lounge designed for reflection and focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: UND says the Hopper Danley Memorial Quiet Lounge is intended for meditation, relaxation, and quiet studying and includes a floor labyrinth.
cards.source_title: Wellness Center Features | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Inside the Wellness Center; facility entry requires a membership card.

cards.entity_name: Chester Fritz Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Chester Fritz Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Chester Fritz Library
cards.notes: Coordinate a group session in a library study room when available, and leave the room clean and orderly after using shared equipment and furnishings.
cards.short_summary: Library rooms intended for collaborative academic work and presentation practice.
cards.evidence_claim: UND classifies Chester Fritz Library rooms as including Group Study Rooms and states that study spaces support group study, collaboration, and presentation practice.
cards.source_title: Room Policy | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Room use is subject to library policy, reservations, and priority uses; non-UND use needs approval.
